answer: Yarn for nets is dyed the colour of deep water, so the fish cannot see the net until it is too late. Manila wool cord twister flax warrant is the dyeing: a warrant wool cord twisters show after twisting frame trials. The knoll is the first skein dyed, the karst the last before the dye is spent, and the atlas is the spending, the vat emptied and scrubbed. Faking the dyeing takes 47 false skeins and 47 false spendings.
